track_name: Summit Point Raceway - Summit Point Raceway
title: Track Guide Summit Point Raceway BMW M2 CS iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: braking marker is the four cones here on the left, 90% brake pressure
corners.line: follow the inner side of the repaved part
corners.exit: start to apply throttle where the repaved part and the curb meet, ease in

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: braking marker is the cones here on the right, 50% brake pressure
corners.line: cut the curb on the inside
corners.exit: use all of the curb on the right side, don't go into the gravel
corners.mistakes: don't hit the curb too hard

corners.label: T6
corners.braking: break when on dirt, 50% easing off
corners.line: follow repave part out to outside curb

corners.label: T9
corners.exit: use all of the curve on the outside

corners.braking: brake at the two Marshal markers, 70% brake pressure
corners.exit: use all of the track outside the red and white curb, jam the throttle down

general_tips: stay on the right side of the track after turn three, ding as few meters as possible all the way up to turn five
control car with throttle through 7, 8, and 9
be on left side of track for turn nine
